Stated Claim / Post Context:
Houthis Launch Missile Attack On Riyadh International Airport As Blasts Shock Saudi Capital

‘King Khalid International Airport was targeted’

Actual Article Body:
(Photo by Mohammed HUWAIS / AFP via Getty Images)

Explosions rocked the Saudi Arabian capital of Riyadh after Iranian-backed Houthi rebels launched missiles Saturday at King Khalid International Airport.

At least five people were critically injured after two explosions shook the major airport, which has come under attack at least two other times in the last week, the New York Post reported. The Saudi Civil Aviation Authority confirmed the strikes in a post to X, reporting several injuries and temporarily suspending flights. (RELATED: Trump Reportedly Called Off Houthi Strikes As Bombs Were Being Loaded Onto US Planes)

#Statement | An attack targeted King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, and operations are temporarily suspended. #GACA https://t.co/5vhxoGBVc7

“The General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) announces that on Saturday, October 10, 2026, corresponding to 29 Rabi Al-Thani 1488H, King Khalid International Airport was targeted by an attack, amid continued attacks targeting civil aviation facilities in the Kingdon,” the aviation agency posted. “The attack resulted in a number of injuries, which are currently being assessed.”

President Donald Trump, meanwhile, signaled an openness to assisting a Saudi military response.

“We may,” Trump told reporters Saturday at the White House. “We’re going to look at it. We just found out about the recent attack, so we’ll make a decision. We move very quickly.”

The United States and Israel launched military strikes against Iran on Feb. 28 after talks regarding the Islamic regime’s nuclear weapons program broke down. Trump and other administration officials asserted that program was “obliterated” after the June 2025 strike against multiple Iranian nuclear sites, but maintained Iran posed a threat to the U.S. without providing specific details.

The New York Times reported April 7 that, although there was skepticism among administration officials, including Vice President JD Vance, Trump was persuaded to authorize the military campaign against Iran following a February meeting at the White House with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

TRENDING

Stated Claim / Post Context:
Unhinged lefties attack ICE agents in Oregon parking lot, smash vehicle with bat: video

Unhinged anti-ICE rioters were caught on video threatening federal agents and attacking their vehicle while attempting to trap them inside an Oregon parking lot.

Actual Article Body:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

Unhinged anti-ICE rioters threatened federal agents and attacked their vehicle while attempting to trap them inside an Oregon parking lot, video of the incident shows.

Jaw-dropping footage shared by The Post Millennial journalist Katie Daviscourt shows a chaotic clash erupting in Salem Saturday between lefty lunatics and the feds.

One member of the mob is seen swinging a baseball bat and knocking off a sideview mirror of a black federal vehicle slowly driving through the lot, the video shows.

Graphic content warning:

Breaking: ICE agents were physically attacked on Friday by anti-ICE agitators in Salem, Oregon.Agitators are stalking their whereabouts and interfering with operations as ICE increases activity in the state. pic.twitter.com/7ezXeLTjj1

Masked thugs seemingly trail the vehicle they are trying to block in.

“Get the f–k out of Salem!” one woman is heard screaming as others continue to belligerently shout profanities.

Footage also captured horns blaring as anti-ICE “rapid responders” tried boxing the agents in.

Agents deployed tear gas and other “crowd control measures” to try and stop the madness, Daviscourt reported.

She shared even more alarming footage depicting anti-ICE attacks in Salem on Friday, including a clip first posted by stopice.net, in which a protester appears to grab an agent by the neck and throw a punch before the agitator is sprayed with what appears to be tear gas or mace.

“Watching ICE heroes get physically attacked over and over is INFURIATING,” wrote conservative commentator Nick Sortor on X, while reacting to the video Daviscourt shared Saturday.

ICE did not immediately return a request for comment.
